patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Customer.io and Drip share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Customer.io only if your buying job matches “Product-led event-driven messaging across email, push, SMS, and in-app — MAP-adjacent to c” rather than Drip's shape. Choose Drip only if your buying job matches “Ecommerce CRM/email platform with behavior-driven automation and contact-tier pricing from” rather than Customer.io's shape. Workflow advantage: Customer.io leans shared coverage; Drip leans small-business-campaigns. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Customer.io and Drip share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Customer.io is Product-led event-driven messaging across email, push, SMS, and in-app — MAP-adjacent to classic ESPs.; Drip is Ecommerce CRM/email platform with behavior-driven automation and contact-tier pricing from $39/mo..
- Company-size focus: Customer.io (small-business, mid-market, enterprise) vs Drip (small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Customer.io-leaning — vs Drip-leaning small-business-campaigns.
- Researched limits: Customer.io — Essentials from $100/mo — not an SMB freemium ESP; Drip — No forever-free plan — trial-only entry from $39/mo.

Limitations — Customer.io: Essentials from $100/mo — not an SMB freemium ESP; Event/profile model requires product data maturity; Drip: No forever-free plan — trial-only entry from $39/mo; Contact-tier pricing rises as the store list grows.

Poor-fit cases: Customer.io is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Essentials from $100/mo — not an SMB freemium ESP · Drip is a poor fit when that limitation bites: No forever-free plan — trial-only entry from $39/mo · Avoid Customer.io if you actually need Drip's motion (Ecommerce CRM/email platform with behavior-driven automation and contact-tier pr)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
